prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Test Your Pet's Desktop Controls", "Try out pet commands in this interactive playground before placing your companion on your desktop.", "Desktop Companion Controls"]
1: ["Desktop Display Health Check", "Verifying screen overlay permissions and system tray access before spawning your pet.", "Screen overlay permission active"]
2: ["Account & Pet Cloud Protection", "Review your existing saved pets and cloud sync status before completing sign in.", "Cloud Pet Backup Active"]
3: []
4: ["Crafting Your Desktop Companion", "Rendering taking longer than expected? Click here for display tips."]
5: ["Use a clear, well-lit photo showing your pet's full face for optimal 3D desktop rendering.", "Upload Pet Photo"]
6: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your pet is officially registered and ready to move to your desktop workspace!"]
7: ["Choose Your Path & Unlock Starter Accessory", "Select a path now to receive an exclusive desktop hat for your pet.", "Exclusive Desktop Accessory Included"]
8: ["Generating Pet in Background", "Feel free to work on other tasks. We will notify you the instant your pet is ready on your desktop."]
9: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Sign in securely to preserve your pet profiles across desktop reinstalls."]

verdicts.problem: Promises a gift or free extra item for completing a step.
